item.title: Add --max-turns to agent invocations
item.intent: Prevent runaway agents from spinning indefinitely within the timeout, burning tokens on repetitive tool calls without making progress.
item.description: run_agent_process() builds claude args but never sets --max-turns. A stuck agent can loop tool calls until the timeout kills it. Add per-role max-turns defaults: developer ~25, validator ~10, groomer ~15. Make configurable via config.yaml and env overrides.
steps: Add MAX_TURNS_DEVELOPER, MAX_TURNS_VALIDATOR, MAX_TURNS_GROOMER defaults in the defaults section
Add config.yaml keys (agent.max_turns.developer, etc.) and AISHORE_ env overrides
In run_agent_process(), accept a max_turns parameter and add --max-turns to claude_args
Pass the appropriate max_turns from run_agent() based on agent_name
Update CONFIGURATION.md with the new config keys and env vars

acceptanceCriteria.text: Default max-turns values exist in the defaults section
Max-turns is configurable via env var
New config keys documented in CONFIGURATION.md
